variants.name: Page (paper on app-background)
findings: In the atlas cell the host body is white, so the Page specimen shows white panels on white: only the hairline separates them. Real screens are correct (#fff on #f6f7f1).

findings.text: The Page specimen does not show its defining trait in the atlas: the cell canvas renders white, so the paper panel blends into it.
findings.fix: In variants/page.html give the [data-st-context=page] cell background:var(--app-background), as drawer.html sets paper.

findings.text: In the specimens the second heading (Pen) sits about 8px under the Facts panel and about 20px above its own Row group, so it reads as belonging to the block above.
findings.fix: Separate the two blocks in the specimen with space-section (the README's own rule), e.g. wrap each heading+block in a section with margin-top var(--space-section).

findings.text: Summary/hero cards beside Panels still carry a faint shadow (tk-summary, task-context-card, home-task-card, inspect-pen: 0 3px 12px rgba(38,53,30,.016)), so elevation is inconsistent with 'panels are not shadowed'.
findings.fix: Drop the shadow on those cards or name the summary card as the one sanctioned exception in the DS README.
